summary: Independent structural-causal pass tested the open AV-certification constraint hypothesis and refreshed the large-load/grid constraint context. Primary NHTSA evidence supports certification/regulatory throughput as a real constraint distinct from core autonomy capability: purpose-built AVs may require exemptions or face certification audits even when technical operation exists. However, entity-level materiality across the active Earth universe is not yet fully mapped, so no canonical edge promotion is proposed. FERC evidence continues to support large-load interconnection rules as a separate grid bottleneck affecting data-center and industrial demand timing.

materialFindings.finding: NHTSA's September 4, 2026 Cybercab audit shows that technical deployment and FMVSS self-certification are separable states; commercial operation can trigger certification scrutiny after deployment.

NHTSA's July 30, 2026 action allowing limited Zoox robotaxi commercial deployment through a temporary exemption demonstrates regulatory throughput can function as an enabling gate for purpose-built AVs lacking conventional controls.

NHTSA's June 25, 2026 FMVSS brake-pedal rulemaking confirms standards are actively adapting to ADS-only vehicle architectures, reinforcing that certification architecture is not identical to autonomy software capability.

FERC's 2026 large-load actions continue to identify interconnection process and tariff design as a material timing constraint for data centers and other large loads, independent of generation-equipment manufacturing capacity.

unknowns: Which active Earth autonomy companies have direct exposure to purpose-built-vehicle certification/exemption throughput versus conventional vehicle platforms.
Magnitude and expected duration of certification delay as an economic bottleneck by company.
Whether standards reform materially reduces this constraint faster than deployment scales.

peerRequests.request: Map active-universe autonomy names to vehicle architecture, certification route, exemption dependence and disclosed deployment timelines before any company-level causal edge is promoted.
Track new NHTSA exemption, audit and FMVSS actions as sensor evidence, but keep them non-gating until entity relevance and materiality are verified.

blockingIssues.issue: Entity-level materiality and falsifier thresholds are incomplete, so certification throughput should not yet be promoted as a canonical company edge.
